summary: Adaptation drafts were checked with a number pattern that missed numbers at a sentence end or next to Chinese text and misread signs, exponents and grouping, so a wrong number in a draft could pass.

observables: check_adaptation verdict of an audience adaptation draft against its communication record
impact.bias: a 9.99 draft against a 1.02 record passed: numbers at a sentence end or touching CJK text were not read, -0.50 was read as 0.50, 1.2e-3 as 3 and 12,000 as 12 and 000
impact.trigger: an adaptation draft (English or Chinese) whose numbers end a sentence, touch CJK characters, carry a sign or exponent, or use digit grouping

applies_to.match_basis: claims is required in every communication artifact and adaptation.py records no field of its own, so no field shows that an adaptation draft was made

remedy: check the adaptation drafts again (check_adaptation) with a release that has the fix; an unmapped or mismatched number is now reported
